worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.summary: The user gathers the faint light around its body and lets it burst outward, hitting every nearby foe at once: closer foes take more, and those caught in the flash are left dazzled and slower for a while. Scatter spreads wider and evens the edge; Focus hits harder and dazzles longer.
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.use.0: Flash the ring of foes pressing in
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.use.1: Clear out small targets that swarm around you
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.use.2: Slow a whole ring of foes with dazzle
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.descript: The ring of light deals one flash hit to each foe: the %1$s power at the centre falls to about %2$s%% at the outer edge. The foe's Special Defence, type matchups and critical hits are settled on impact.
Light radius %1$s blocks (air and ground together); a foe caught in it is dazzled and moves about %2$s seconds slower.
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.wide.on: Scatter on: light radius about ×1.22 and a more even edge, but slower to cast, about ×0.88 power and a shorter dazzle.
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.wide.off: Scatter off (Focus): about ×1.14 power and a longer dazzle, with the radius down to about ×0.82.
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.timing: Radius %1$s blocks; after a %2$s-second prepare it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s seconds; cooldown %5$s seconds from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.growth.0: At level %1$s, flash power rises to %2$s and light radius to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.dazzlinggleam.preferen: On: light radius about ×1.22 and a more even edge, but slower to cast, about ×0.88 power and a shorter dazzle, to sweep more targets. Off (Focus): about ×1.14 power and a longer dazzle with the radius down to about ×0.82, to flash one or two close targets harder.
The companion only considers the flash while a threat is within this distance; smaller flashes only when hugged, larger walks in first.
Flashes only when at least this many visible hostile foes stand this close; larger keeps it for being surrounded, 1 flashes even one.
